FaqSection.title: Frequently asked questions
FaqSection.subtitle: Answers about importing, customs, and delivering commercial vehicles from Europe.

customs.question: Do you handle customs clearance?
customs.answer: Yes. We take care of full customs clearance: documents, certificates, and border support so the vehicle arrives in Ukraine legally.

vat.question: Is VAT included in the listed prices?
vat.answer: No. Catalog prices are the vehicle cost without VAT or customs fees. The final amount with taxes is calculated individually for each model.

delivery.question: What are the delivery times?
delivery.answer: It depends on the country, availability, and logistics. Delivery from the EU usually takes 7 to 21 days after the deal is confirmed. We agree the exact timeline before payment.

inspection.question: Can I inspect the vehicle before purchase?
inspection.answer: Yes. We can arrange an inspection at an EU yard or provide a detailed photo and video report, a technical inspection report, and service history.
